entries.title: Your first crewmate comes with a short note on what happens next
entries.body: The first time the first mate hands your ask to a crewmate, a note says the crewmate works in the background, that its answer or a choice comes back as a card, and that cards are the only part that needs you. It shows once, and if the How we work card is still open, the note takes its place.

picture.alt: A note titled A crewmate is on it, with two panels, Now: a crewmate works, and Later: a card comes back here, above a Got it button.
